author: Zephyr I
title: Stop-grad between double-step ConvLSTM updates (std-width nodil, BASE_SEED=42)
abstract: Test whether stopping gradients from step-2 into step-1 state in the double-step LN-ConvLSTM improves stability/returns under the 30-min cap. Std-width 32/64, d=5 on main convs, undilated 3×3 bottlenecks (ratio=0.25), 1-head AttnPool, AdamW+clip; BASE_SEED=42.
